body.purpose: Default UI copy, the large majority of on-screen text.

label.purpose: Section labels — always uppercase, 0.18em-tracked, Signal Blue.

shadows.name: primary-button-rest
shadows.purpose: Resting shadow under primary buttons only — the one element allowed a shadow at rest, per the Single-Accent Rule.

shadows.name: card-hover-glow
shadows.purpose: Combined lift shadow + blue halo on card/button hover, per the Quiet-At-Rest Rule.

motion.name: shimmer-sweep
motion.purpose: Diagonal light sweep across a surface on hover/focus, structural not ambient.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one clear action per view. Signal Blue fill with a resting glow, lift + shimmer on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #2DA8FF; color: #03111F; border: 1px solid #2DA8FF; border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 16px; font: 600 14px Inter, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(45,168,255,0.22); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 220ms ease, border-color 220ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border-color: #6BC4FF; box-shadow: 0 9px 24px rgba(45,168,255,0.28), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.18); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A filled action a visible step down from primary — Quiet Teal, no resting glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #0E3A5F; color: #E7F4FF; border: 1px solid #0E3A5F; border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 16px; font: 600 14px Inter, sans-serif; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 220ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { border-color: rgba(45,168,255,0.58); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Transparent, low-emphasis action that inherits whatever surface it sits on.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #F3F8FC; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 16px; font: 600 14px Inter, sans-serif; transition: border-color 220ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover, .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { border-color: rgba(45,168,255,0.58); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The system's signature surface — layered translucent glass with a fine inner highlight, quiet at rest, glowing lift on hover.
components.html:
Today's revenue
$1,240 across 6 completed jobs.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(8,34,57,0.48), rgba(10,32,53,0.64)); border: 1px solid rgba(243,248,252,0.16); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.18), 0 18px 45px rgba(0,0,0,0.36); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(145%); transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 300ms ease, box-shadow 300ms ease; } .ds-card:hover, .ds-card:focus-visible { border-color: rgba(45,168,255,0.48); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.22), 0 20px 45px rgba(0,0,0,0.36), 0 0 28px rgba(45,168,255,0.14); transform: translateY(-5px); } .ds-card-title { font: 600 18px Inter, sans-serif; color: #F3F8FC; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-card-body { font: 400 14px Inter, sans-serif; color: #9BB6CB; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Fully pill-shaped, dense status/tag indicator. Never wraps.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; white-space: nowrap; background: #2DA8FF; color: #03111F; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font: 600 12px Inter, sans-serif; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Deliberately flat and transparent — the one control that never gets glass treatment, so typed text stays legible.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 36px; background: transparent; color: #F3F8FC; border: 1px solid #1B3E5C; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 12px; font: 400 14px Inter, sans-serif; transition: box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9BB6CB; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #63BFFF; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Recessed chrome one shade darker than content surfaces; Signal Blue marks the active route.
components.css: .ds-sidebar { background: #061928; padding: 12px; border-radius: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-item { display: block; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 10px; font: 500 14px Inter, sans-serif; color: #D3E4F0; text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(45,168,255,0.10); } .ds-nav-item--active { background: rgba(45,168,255,0.16); color: #6BC4FF; }

narrative.overview: Mobull's screens read like a precision instrument at night — a deep, near-black navy foundation with electric blue readouts, translucent glass surfaces, and quiet hairline borders. Nothing glows or announces itself until it's touched; the system stays calm and legible at rest, and Signal Blue reserves itself for the single clearest action in any view. This fits a product whose whole premise is telling a mobile business owner the truth about a job's real cost before they commit — the interface itself should feel like something you'd trust to give you a straight answer in the dark. The system explicitly rejects the flat, interchangeable look of a generic SaaS admin dashboard. Depth — real translucency, blur, and a restrained blue halo — is the point, not an incumbent style to strip away in the name of simplicity.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first: the product ships in dark mode only today; light-mode tokens exist in the source but are not currently reachable in the shipped app.
Layered glass, not flat cards: panels and buttons carry real translucency, blur, and a fine inner highlight rather than a solid fill.
Structural glow, not ambient decoration: every halo, shimmer, and lift is a direct response to hover/focus/active.
One accent, used sparingly: Signal Blue marks the one clear action per view.

rules.name: The Single-Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue marks the one clear action per view. If two elements on the same screen both want the primary treatment, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Recessed Chrome Rule
rules.body: Navigation chrome (the sidebar) always sits one shade darker than the content surfaces it frames, so wayfinding never visually competes with content.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Section labels are always uppercase, semibold, 0.18em-tracked, and colored Signal Blue — this is the system's one recurring typographic flourish.

rules.name: The Quiet-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Every glass surface is flat and quiet until it's touched — halo, shimmer, and lift only appear on hover, focus, or active.

rules.name: The Flat Input Rule
rules.body: Form fields stay flat and transparent — glass treatment is reserved for containers and actions, never for data-entry fields.

dos: Do reserve Signal Blue for the one clearest action per view.
Do keep every glow, shimmer, and lift a direct response to hover/focus/active.
Do use a real Empty state (icon + title + description + actionable CTA) for zero-data screens instead of seeded or fabricated example content.
Do keep the sidebar/nav chrome one shade darker than the content surfaces it frames.
donts: Don't apply glass-panel treatment to form inputs.
Don't let the system drift toward a flat, generic SaaS-dashboard look.
Don't add ambient or idle animation to a surface at rest.
Don't reintroduce the retired orange/coral gradient wordmark.
